notes:
OCRelay 1.1.20

FIX: "NO MEASUREMENTS FOUND HERE" ON SOME WORKSHEETS

• On some worksheets — mostly carotid — the scan came back empty even though the region was right. The AI was writing out its working before giving the values, and ran out of room before it got to them. It now has more room, is told to give the values alone, and OCRelay finds the values even if the AI does explain itself first.

FIX: REVIEW PANEL ON A NARROW MONITOR

• Since 1.1.18, on a monitor too narrow for the panel (such as a portrait monitor), rows and warnings that appeared once the values arrived could be squeezed out of sight. The panel now makes room by shrinking the worksheet picture, and grows to show everything.

• A panel you have moved to another monitor now stays there.

FIX: TEST FROM FILE

• Test from File now handles LE arterial boxes written as two numbers (138.0/8.6) the same way a normal capture does.
